questions.body_en: Shawn and Matthew have 76 books altogether. The number of books Shawn has is 3 times the number of books Matthew has. How many books does Shawn have?

questions.body_en:

m ※ n = (m + n) ÷ 2

Find the value of 3 ※ (6 ※ 8).

questions.body_en: A whole number n is multiplied by 6. 6 is then added to this product, after which the sum is divided by 6. Finally, 6 is subtracted from the quotient, which still gives a value of 6. Find the value of n.
questions.body_id: Sebuah bilangan bulat n dikalikan dengan 6. Kemudian 6 ditambahkan ke hasil perkalian ini, setelah itu jumlahnya dibagi 6. Terakhir, 6 dikurangkan dari hasil bagi tersebut, yang masih menghasilkan nilai 6. Temukan nilai n.

questions.body_en:
Some teenagers are being questioned by the traffic police.

Adrian: I have a driving license.
Ben: I do not know how to drive.
Chris: Ben does not know how to drive.

Given that only one person is telling the truth, which of the following conclusions can we make?
questions.body_id:
Beberapa remaja sedang diinterogasi oleh polisi lalu lintas.

Adrian: Saya memiliki SIM.
Ben: Saya tidak tahu cara mengemudi.
Chris: Ben tidak tahu cara mengemudi.

Diketahui bahwa hanya satu orang yang berkata jujur, kesimpulan mana yang dapat kita buat?

choices_en.label: A

choices_en.label: B
choices_en.text: Both Ben and Chris can drive

choices_id.label: A
choices_id.text: Adrian dan Ben keduanya bisa mengemudi

choices_id.label: B

questions.body_en:
In Mathematics,

1² = 1 × 1 = 1
2² = 2 × 2 = 4
3² = 3 × 3 = 9
...

It is also observed that

2² = 1² + 3
3² = 2² + 5
4² = 3² + 7
5² = 4² + 9
...

21² = a² + b

Find the value of (a + b).
questions.body_id:
Dalam Matematika,

1² = 1 × 1 = 1
2² = 2 × 2 = 4
3² = 3 × 3 = 9
...

Diamati juga bahwa

2² = 1² + 3
3² = 2² + 5
4² = 3² + 7
5² = 4² + 9
...

21² = a² + b

Temukan nilai (a + b).

questions.body_en:

Ada berapa titik pada segi enam ke-49?

questions.body_en:
Megan was walking along a straight road. She met an oncoming car and she asked the driver, "Did you overtake a cyclist just now?"

"Yes, 10 minutes ago," the driver replied.

After walking for another 10 minutes, Megan met the cyclist.

Given that the cyclist's speed was 4 times Megan's walking speed, how many times of Megan's speed was the driver's speed?
questions.body_id:
Megan sedang berjalan di sepanjang jalan lurus. Ia bertemu dengan mobil yang datang dari arah berlawanan dan bertanya kepada pengemudi, "Apakah Anda baru saja mendahului seorang pengendara sepeda?"

"Ya, 10 menit yang lalu," jawab pengemudi.

Setelah berjalan 10 menit lagi, Megan bertemu dengan pengendara sepeda.

Diketahui bahwa kecepatan pengendara sepeda adalah 4 kali kecepatan berjalan Megan, berapa kali kecepatan Megan adalah kecepatan pengemudi?
